items.title: NVDA Stock: Where Compounding Could Take The Price
items.summary: This is no longer just a chip company; it is becoming the central bank for the AI revolution. NVIDIA is helping establish financing platforms to raise over $500 billion of third-party capital for its customers. It has also directly invested nearly $50 billion in the Frontier AI labs, effectively underwriting its own demand.

items.title: JPMorgan Built a Version of JEPI Designed to Keep the IRS Waiting
items.summary: JEPI's monthly income has made it a default choice for yield-hungry investors, but a quiet tax problem erodes those payouts for anyone holding shares in a taxable account. JPMorgan just launched two sibling funds designed to shift when the IRS collects, and the tradeoffs are not obvious.
